cohort: The study included 2095 HBsAg carriers and 23,019 normal pregnant women in China from January 2018 to June 2022.
finding: Compared with normal pregnant women, HBsAg carriers have a higher risk of intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy and lower birth weight infants, but a lower risk of gestational hypothyroidism and pregnancy induced hypertension.
birth_weight: lower in the HBsAg carrier group
